preconditions.description: The length of the string E is between 1 and 10^4.
The number of plus and minus operators, P and M, are between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: P + M = number of '?' in E
preconditions.description: The sum of P and M is equal to the number of '?' in the expression E.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum possible value of the expression after inserting the plus and minus operators.
